architecture.mechanism: CNN and Transformer-based anomaly detection with adaptive receptive field adjustment via ant-lion optimization
architecture.intervention: Integrate the proposed CNN-Transformer model with ant-lion optimization into the 2022 Kia Soul's CAN bus monitoring system to detect signal anomalies indicative of impending ECU or sensor failures that could cause sudden engine shutdown.
architecture.expected_effect: Early identification of network attacks or signal corruption patterns allows for fail-safe modes or driver alerts before catastrophic engine failure or starter system compromise occurs, extending operational reliability past 61,000 miles.
architecture.falsification_test: Inject simulated head gasket failure sensor data and starter circuit fault codes into the vehicle's CAN bus during highway-speed operation simulations; if the system fails to flag these specific anomaly sequences within 50 milliseconds, the mechanism is ineffective.
